title: Public inquest will probe death of man killed by Burnaby RCMP
article: The BC Coroners Service will conduct a public inquest into the death of a man killed by Burnaby RCMP last year.

Ryan Allen Walter Jacob, 45, was shot and killed in a police shooting following an interaction with Mounties near East Hastings Street and Macdonald Avenue on Jan. 31, 2013, according to the BC Coroners Service.
According to reports, Jacob was the son of Squamish First Nation Chief Gibby Jacob.
The public inquest will hear evidence from witnesses to determine facts surrounding the death.
While the findings will not have any legal implications, the court will have the opportunity to make recommendations aimed at preventing similar deaths in the future.
The inquest will begin on July 28.
